info.name: InstaGallery Local Development
info.description: Local collection for http://localhost:8080. Register, login, refresh, and Google login save JWT_TOKEN and REFRESH_TOKEN. The server stores the refresh token as HMAC-SHA256 and returns the raw token once. Chat create returns conversationId and isNew. Booking time uses yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss. 2FA routes return 501. 139 REST /api/v1 requests, plus root, health, and the WebSocket entry.

request.description: Plain text health. Does not check MySQL.
userType is CLIENT or PHOTOGRAPHER. Saves access and refresh tokens. Rate limit 5/minute.
Saves JWT_TOKEN and REFRESH_TOKEN from data.
Rotates the refresh token. The previous raw token cannot be used again.
Reset code is hashed. debugResetToken is returned only when EXPOSE_DEBUG_RESET_TOKEN=true.
Send the Google ID token in idToken.
Requires Bearer access token and the raw refresh token in X-Refresh-Token.
Revokes refresh sessions. Log in again.
Mock response. Does not store a file.
One JSON object. An array body is rejected.
commentSetting is ALL, FOLLOWING, or NONE.
Second share by the same user does not increase shareCount.
One comment_reactions row. Like again removes it. Like while disliked switches to LIKE.
Switches the same row to DISLIKE, or removes it if already disliked.
Binary upload of the file named by the presigned URL. Send the file as the body, with Authorization Bearer.
Album media points at posts, not individual photos.

query.description: Optional owner. Defaults to the caller.

request.description: Public. A valid Bearer token saves search history. Same user and query updates one row.
Returns conversationId and isNew. One DIRECT thread per user pair.
Skips conversations hidden by the caller.
Sets hidden_at. Does not delete the membership row.
WebSocket at ws://localhost:8080/api/v1/ws/chat?token={{JWT_TOKEN}}. Open it as a WebSocket request in Postman. The token is verified with JwtManager.
Push delivery needs a Firebase service account. Without it, in-app notifications still save.
JSON array. Empty schedule closes the photographer.
bookingDate is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss. Overlap returns BOOKING_SLOT_UNAVAILABLE. Empty schedule returns BOOKING_OUTSIDE_AVAILABILITY.
PENDING, CONFIRMED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, REJECTED.
Cancels the booking and frees the time slot.
Same reporter and target returns the existing report. targetType: POST, COMMENT, USER, BOOKING, MESSAGE, RATING.
